title: SAML setup wizard: attribute mapper, RBAC v2 sync, and audit trail integration
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Goal: Add an end-to-end flow in the SAML 2.0 setup wizard to (1) let admins declaratively map incoming SAML attributes to RBAC v2 roles/groups, (2) verify metadata exchange + certificate validity as part of the same guided flow, and (3) emit structured admin-level audit events for every mapping change and handshake verification step.

Background: Customers running Private/Dedicated deployments ask for a shorter path from identity provider onboarding to role sync. Currently the SAML setup wizard validates metadata and creates a connector, but RBAC v2 group/role assignments are done manually in a separate UI. This causes drift, onboarding friction, and gaps in the audit trail when operators reconcile mappings after the fact.

Requirements (MUST):
- Wizard UI step to configure attribute mappings: attribute -> principal type (user, group) -> RBAC v2 role(s). Support simple attribute (e.g., groups, eduPersonEntitlement) and regex capture for attributes with prefixes.
- Synchronous validation of mapping rules against a small sample of IdP assertions (test harness that can ingest a sample SAMLResponse or generate a synthetic assertion).
- Metadata exchange validation: confirm entityID, ACS URLs, x509 cert chain parse, signature verification, and certificate expiry check. Report warnings for certificate rotation windows and time skew.
- Emit structured audit events to the platform audit pipeline for: connector-created, mapping-created/updated/deleted, test-assertion-run (result: pass|warn|fail), metadata-verified (result details), and admin-override actions. Events must include actor, connector_id, mapping_delta, timestamp, and correlation_id.
- Operator visible summary that shows exactly which RBAC v2 roles will be granted by the mapping and a simulated list of affected principals for the sample assertion.
- Backwards compatibility: existing connectors without mappings should continue to function; wizard should offer a no-op skip.

Acceptance criteria:
- PM/Design sign-off on wizard screens and error states.
- E2E automated test that exercises a golden SAMLResponse and validates mapping results against RBAC v2 test harness.
- Audit events emitted and visible in staging audit viewer with required fields.
- Integration test for certificate rotation edge case (primary cert expired but secondary still valid).

Technical approach:
- Attribute mapping engine: reuse parts of attribute parsing library from old SSO service, add a declarative mapping schema (JSON Lines) stored in connector config. Mappings are evaluated on the platform side during token exchange and on-demand when admin runs the test assertion.
- RBAC v2 sync: on mapping save, run a dry-run that calculates delta (grants/revokes) and persist mapping only after operator confirmation. Actual role assignment will happen via the platform RBAC sync job; implement an opt-in immediate sync flag for admins.
- Audit logging: extend audit protobuf schema (audit.v1) with new fields mapping_delta and assertion_sample. Wire into existing audit writer to S3/Kafka and ensure GDPR-safe sanitization (truncate full assertion, store hash).
- Metadata validation: extend current metadata parser with tolerant whitespace & encoding handling and explicitly surface issuer mismatch vs expected entityID as an actionable warning.

Design trade-offs and decisions considered:
- Inline role assignment vs separate sync job: chose separate sync job with opt-in immediate mode to limit blast radius and allow staged rollouts.
- Store full SAML assertions in audit logs: decided to store only a hashed pointer and a redacted sample to avoid PII leakage.

Rollout plan:
1) Feature-flag the wizard additions behind sso-attrmap-2025.02.
2) Ship UI in staging, run manual onboarding with internal IdPs.
3) Enable audit events aggregation and confirm fields in internal audit dashboard.
4) Gradually enable immediate sync for low-risk orgs, monitor for unexpected grants.

Testing & QA:
- Unit tests for mapping schema validation (regex, missing attributes).
- Integration tests: golden assertion -> expected RBAC v2 delta.
- Load test: simulate 100 concurrent admins running the test harness to ensure no downstream rate-limiting on the RBAC sync job.

Security notes:
- security_review_required: true. Contact security@redwood.ai for threat modelling session.
- KMS usage: any persisted mapping deltas or redacted assertion snapshots must be encrypted with customer KMS when in Private deployments.

Next steps:
- Finalize UI copy with Design (see attachment).
- Spike: build test assertion generator and run across 3 IdP metadata samples (Okta, AzureAD, OneLogin).
